_comment: Offence guides with elements and facts in issue. Element quotes are verbatim from installed provisions (checked at build). Statutory elements are not a complete statement of what must be proven: mental-element and interpretive questions are defined by case law that is not installed. Editorial drafts.

exculpatory_prompts: Was there any indication that force was used against the person first, or threatened?
